title: Property Maintenance staged evidence rebuilt
details: Property Maintenance practical repairs now use real one-stage-at-a-time evidence packs instead of the old single-photo instructions
The staged evidence screen stays fixed in Evia's existing evidence area so photo, video, explanation and save steps no longer resize and jump between different layouts
Photo evidence uses a large 1:1 camera, then goes directly to its required written explanation
Guided video stays as one continuous recording with audio, Next prompt timestamp markers and optional extra text afterwards
Accepted evidence and the current unfinished stage are kept locally so Evia can resume the same task later
summary: Evia v132 rebuilds staged evidence as one stable Evia flow and updates Property Maintenance itself.
changes: Added staged evidence data directly to the Property Maintenance ST0171 course
Replaced the competing photo and video handoff scripts with one fixed staged evidence controller
Kept the staged flow anchored inside Evia's existing learner UI
Added local stage and accepted-media resume support
Moved the offline shell to v132
